{npc:Sinatuki}, a Chakoya banished from her tribe, lives in {wiki:Nibelor|Nibelor} and is very hungry. Give her 100 fish ({item:Green Perch|Green Perches} or {item:Rainbow Trout|Rainbow Trouts}) and she rewards you with 5 {item:Shard|Shards} and the achievement **Jamjam**.
Access to Nibelor: complete the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest|Barbarian Test Quest} and {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest|The Ice Islands Quest} up to the mission *Nibelor 5: Cure the Dogs*.
or Rainbow Trouts, or a mix of both (100 in total)
Ways to get the fish: {wiki:Ice Fishing|ice fishing} in Svargrond and surroundings, loot from Chakoyas or other creatures, or buying from other players.
Sinatuki eats **the whole stack** of fish at a time. Keep track of how many fish you have in your inventory on each hand-in.

Collect a total of 100 {item:Green Perch|Green Perches} and/or {item:Rainbow Trout|Rainbow Trouts}: ice fish in Svargrond and surroundings, loot them from Chakoyas and other creatures, or buy them from other players.

Split the fish into a stack of **99** and **1 fish apart** (keep it in the depot or on another character for now). That way you avoid Sinatuki eating 100 fish at once and you having to hand in one more.

In **Svargrond** (boat from **Carlin**, **Thais** or **Venore**: say {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes} to the captain; you arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the **east** part of the city), go to the ice area **north** of the city and talk to {npc:Iskan}, the owner of the dog sled: {key:hi}, {key:passage}. He takes you to the island of {wiki:Nibelor} (only after the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest} and the first mission of {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest}).

Go to Nibelor and talk to {npc:Sinatuki}. Say {key:hi}, {key:chuqua} and {key:nupi}. She eats the first stack of fish you have. If you have the fish in several stacks, repeat {key:chuqua} and {key:nupi} until you have handed in **99 fish** in total.
If you have a stack of 100 fish, take one out of your inventory before handing it in. Otherwise she eats the whole stack and you still have to give her one more fish.
After giving 99 fish, bring **one** fish and say {key:chuqua} and {key:nupi}. She eats it and gives you five shiny crystals: 5 {item:Shard|Shards}. You also earn the **Jamjam** achievement.

To return to Svargrond, talk to {npc:Nilsor}, **west** of the Nibelor stone circle, and ask for {key:passage}. In Svargrond, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you by boat to other cities ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
